description: The trip risk model's inputs and labels (FMS-155, docs/ml-trip-risk.md). One row is one driver on one trip at t, the trip's scheduled_start: what was known before it started. The driver's record, the job (FMS-153), when it runs, the route's record, and how rested the driver was. The core computes every input from analytics.trip_risk_facts (migration 073) by tripRiskFeatures (maintenance/domain/trip-risk.ts), for training (npm run ml:trip-risk-dataset) and for the dispatch console alike. No protected attribute is an input: no name, age, gender, address or photo.

id_columns.name: trip_id
id_columns.description: The trip's public id, or GEN-T000001 in generated data. Never an input.

id_columns.name: driver_id
id_columns.description: The driver's public id, or GEN-D001. The split holds whole drivers out. Never an input.

id_columns.name: depot_id
id_columns.description: The trip's depot, for the per-depot report. Never an input.

id_columns.name: as_of
id_columns.description: t, the trip's scheduled_start (UTC, ISO 8601). Never an input.

id_columns.name: source
id_columns.description: fleet (exported from the core) or generated (scripts/generate_trip_risk_data.py). A dataset is one or the other; a model trained on generated data is a demonstration.

features.name: driver_trips_90d
features.formula: Count of the driver's completed trips whose actual_end is in [t - 90 days, t). Capped at 500.

features.name: driver_late_share_90d
features.formula: Of the driver's completed trips whose actual_end is in [t - 90 days, t) that had a scheduled_end, the share that were late (as the label late, with the margin of each trip's depot).

features.name: driver_safety_share_90d
features.formula: Of the driver's completed trips whose actual_end is in [t - 90 days, t), the share that had a safety event (as the label safety_event).

features.name: driver_same_load_trips_90d
features.formula: Count of the driver's completed trips whose actual_end is in [t - 90 days, t) whose job load level (FMS-153) is this trip's. Capped at 500.

features.name: driver_same_load_late_share_90d
features.formula: driver_late_share_90d over the same-load trips only.

features.name: job_load_points
features.formula: The trip's job load points (trip/domain/job-load.ts, docs/job-load.md): distance, planned time, stops, night hours and the cargo's share of the payload.

features.name: planned_distance_km
features.formula: trip.trips.planned_distance_km. Capped at 3000.

features.name: planned_duration_h
features.formula: planned_duration_seconds / 3600, else the scheduled window (scheduled_end - scheduled_start). Capped at 72.

features.name: stops
features.formula: The trip's stops (trip.trip_stops). Capped at 100.

features.name: night_hours
features.formula: Hours of [scheduled_start, scheduled_end] between 22:00 and 06:00 in Addis Ababa (nightHours, FMS-153). Capped at 24.

features.name: cargo_share
features.formula: cargo_weight_kg / the vehicle's payload_capacity_kg (FMS-153). Capped at 1.
features.when_missing: 0 (no cargo weight, no vehicle yet, or no payload recorded).

features.name: cargo_hazardous
features.formula: 1 when cargo_kind is hazardous.

features.name: cargo_fragile
features.formula: 1 when cargo_kind is fragile.

features.name: cargo_refrigerated
features.formula: 1 when cargo_kind is refrigerated.

features.name: cargo_passengers
features.formula: 1 when cargo_kind is passengers.

features.name: start_hour
features.formula: The hour of t in Addis Ababa (UTC+3), 0 to 23.
features.when_missing: Never missing: t is always known.

features.name: weekday
features.formula: The weekday of t in Addis Ababa, Monday 0 to Sunday 6.

features.name: hours_since_last_trip
features.formula: Hours from the latest actual_end of the driver's completed trips before t, to t; 0 while the driver is on a trip at t. Capped at 336 (14 days).

features.name: hours_driven_24h
features.formula: Hours of the driver's trips (actual_start to actual_end, or to t while under way) inside [t - 24 h, t).

features.name: hours_driven_7d
features.formula: As hours_driven_24h, inside [t - 7 days, t).

features.name: route_trips_90d
features.formula: Count of the route's completed trips (any driver) whose actual_end is in [t - 90 days, t). Capped at 5000.
features.when_missing: 0 (no route, or none in the window).

features.name: route_late_share_90d
features.formula: Of those with a scheduled_end, the share that were late.

target.name: late
target.definition: 1 when the trip's actual_end is more than trip_delay_minutes (its depot's, else the fleet's, FMS-147) after its scheduled_end; else 0. Training and evaluation only.

target.name: safety_event
target.definition: 1 when a speeding flag was raised on the trip, or the driver had an accident (incident type accident) between its actual_start and actual_end; else 0. Training and evaluation only.

eligible: Completed trips with a driver, a scheduled_start and scheduled_end, an actual_start and actual_end, and a measured distance (actual_distance_source set, FMS-145).
